category_tr: Havuz Isıtma ve Nem Alma Ürünleri
family_description_tr: Nano Spa, kompakt yapısıyla küçük havuz ve spa projelerine özel geliştirilmiştir. Profesyoneller için güvenli ve kolay kurulum avantajı sunar.

bullets_tr: Nano SPA Isıtıcı spalar için ideal bir çözümdür
1 kW ila 8 kW arası boyutlarda mevcuttur
Kontaktör ve termostatı üzerindedir ve kablodur
Ultra güvenilir akış şalteri sayesinde güvenle çalışır
Sıcaklık termostatı ve aşırı ısınma sensörü mevcuttur
Zemin veya dikey olarak duvara monte edilebilir
Nano SPA heater is an ideal solution for spas
Available in sizes from 1 kW up to 8 kW
Fully equipped (Including in the contactor and thermostat on it) and pre-wired
Ultra-reliable flow switch allows safe operation
Supplied with temperature thermostat and overheating sens
Can be wall mounted on floor or vertically
No loss of efficiency throughout its working life

images.alt: A red and black G2C Heat Exchanger unit with a钛管 bundle, shown from a side profile.

Technical drawings of the G2C Heat Exchanger showing dimensions for floor and wall mounting. The floor mounting shows a length L (mm) and a width of 295mm. The wall mounting shows a width of 211mm and a height of 316.5mm. A detail drawing shows a 271.5mm dimension.

Graph showing pressure drop (Bar) vs flow rate (m³/h) for the primary circuit. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 0.3 Bar, and the x-axis ranges from 0 to 6 m³/h. Four curves are shown for different power ratings: G2C 320-kW, G2C 270-kW, G2C 220-kW, and G2C 170-kW.

Graph showing pressure drop (Bar) vs flow rate (m³/h) for the secondary circuit. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 0.4 Bar, and the x-axis ranges from 0 to 32 m³/h. Four curves are shown for different power ratings: G2C 320-kW, G2C 270-kW, G2C 220-kW, and G2C 170-kW.

Diagram of the G2C Heat Exchanger with labels pointing to key features: Akış anahtarı bağlantı noktası Flow switch port, Sıcaklık sensörü portu Temperature sensor port, Titanyum akış tüpü Titanium flow tube (İkincil devre Secondary circuit), Zemin / duvar montaj braketleri Floor / wall mounted brackets, and 85 Titanyum tüp paketi 85 Titanium tube bundle (Birincil devre Primary circuit).
